evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Two matched negative clauses ('No…, and no…') set deliberate contrast: what the contract avoids versus what it preserves.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Two matched verb-phrase alternatives ('polls the run' / 'gets the reaction piggybacked') arranged as a parallel either/or disjunction.
